ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; predominantly high-intensity white/light-gray background (approximately 65%) interspersed with low-intensity dark gray/black pigment disruptions (approximately 35%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive dark mottling and high-contrast contiguous blobs concentrated along the inner notch margins and distal tips. Dark radial streaks extend from the fluke base toward the trailing edge across both high-intensity white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; angle approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, with a deep bounding-box depth extending to the fluke insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and variable-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Distal regions exhibit deep, irregular jagged peaks and valleys, while medial sections show smaller, more regular sawtooth variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the main lobe body, transitioning to a sharp upward/posterior sweep at the distal tips, creating an overall winged geometric profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of small, dark, circular pixel groups concentrated on the extreme distal tips and the irregular margins of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast dark linear marks visible across both lobes, with a higher concentration of long vertical and diagonal marks on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contouring and tissue erosion along the entire trailing edge and tips, creating a highly asymmetrical and jagged profile.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, small, dark circular annular mark is visible in the lower central region of the right lobe.
